methods.label: Express every count in terms of boys
methods.explanation:
To add the three populations in one expression, first write them using the same variable. There are three times as many boys as girls, so \(b=3g\) and \(g=b/3\). There are nine times as many girls as teachers, so
\[
t=\frac{g}{9}=\frac{b}{27}.
\]
The total is therefore
\[
b+g+t=b+\frac b3+\frac b{27}
=\frac{27b+9b+b}{27}
=\boxed{\frac{37}{27}b}.
\]
This is choice B.
